description: Steady base flow of the lid-driven cavity by Newton-GMRES from the t = 600 DNS state of 000_dns (lx1 = 12). The first residual is 4.4e-9: at this order the DNS state, computed with the explicit filter, is a fixed point of the unfiltered map to that level, and Newton ends in two iterations at the tolerance 1e-9. At lx1 = 6 the first residual was 3.5e-5 and Newton went to a second, unstable steady state.

newton_final_residual.note: Final Newton residual (column 7) must not exceed the Newton tolerance (column 8, 1e-9).

newton_first_residual.note: Residual of the DNS seed; it measures how well the DNS state is a fixed point of the unfiltered map.
